name: Multilayer-insulation heat-leak calorimetry with 20 K / 90 K boundaries
plain_name: Multilayer-insulation heat-leak calorimetry with 20 K / 90 K boundaries
description: Measure steady heat leakage through multilayer spacecraft/tank insulation between separate cryogenic boundaries with calibrated conduction calorimetry.

sources.citation: Chato et al., Design and Operation of a Calorimeter for Advanced Multilayer Insulation Testing

reported_conditions.as_printed: nominal 20 K inner and 90 K outer boundaries

requirements.rationale: Nominal inner cold boundary is 20 K.
Nominal outer warm boundary is 90 K.
Guarded geometry and a calibrated heat-flow rod are indispensable.
The documented calorimeter is a vacuum apparatus.

missing_information: Insulation layer count, contact compression, residual gas pressure and rod calibration determine heat leak; no predicted insulation performance is fabricated.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
